result.question: Why was Athaliah taken to the palace grounds to be killed?

readings.answer: Because she must not be put to death in the house of the LORD.
readings.support: She must not be put to death in the house of the LORD.

readings.answer: Because Jehoiada ordered that she be brought out.
readings.support: Jehoiada the priest ordered the commanders of hundreds in charge of the army | Bring her out between the ranks

assessments.reason: The passage explicitly gives this as the reason: “For the priest had said, ‘She must not be put to death in the house of the LORD.’” tying Jehoiada’s instruction to taking her out to be killed elsewhere.

The text says, “Jehoiada the priest ordered… ‘Bring her out between the ranks,’” which is a proximate cause for her being taken out, though it omits the stated rationale that she not be killed in the LORD’s house.
